bio: A small gourmet restaurant surrounded by the verdant landscapes of the Friuli countryside. In what was once a simple farm, owner Guido Lanzellotti has brought this seemingly rustic yet delightfully romantic restaurant to life, creating modern dishes that focuses on top-quality ingredients and careful preparation. Alessio Devidè’s cuisine includes a few local specialities alongside classic Italian dishes which he has reinterpreted with his own personal twist. There’s a huge wine cellar, and if you’re a wine-enthusiast, it’s well worth having a word with the restaurant owner – he has extensive knowledge of the world of wine which he is delighted to share with guests, at the same time as recommending the best labels to accompany your meal....
